title: Oozing Korean Vegetable Dumplings
description: These yeasty, juicy dumplings burst with a savory vegetable filling and a light wholegrain mustard-infused sauce, perfect for a festive Korean dinner.

ingredients.name: infuse oil
ingredients.notes: oil infused with toasted sesame seeds, minced garlic, and grated ginger

instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, and yeast; stir until mixed.
Add warm water and wholegrain mustard; mix until dough starts to form.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough, let rise 30 minutes until doubled in size.
Meanwhile, heat infuse oil in a skillet over medium heat; sauté cabbage, carrot, ginger, and tofu for 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and green onion; cook for 2 minutes until fragrant and allow to cool slightly.
Roll dough into small circles, fill with 1 tbsp of vegetable mixture, and seal edges with water.
Steam dumplings over high heat for 8 minutes until wrappers are translucent and filling is hot.
Assemble steamed dumplings on a platter and drizzle with remaining infuse oil.
Serve hot with a side of fermented mustard sauce.
